definition: band_depth = 1 - F_band / F_cont, where F_band is the mean surface brightness (or flux) of frames whose wavelength lies in the band window and F_cont is the linear interpolation, at the band centre, of the means in the continuum windows. Positive = absorption relative to the local continuum. An empirical contrast index, not an abundance.
caveats: Frames come from different epochs: moving or variable sources contaminate the index.
Indices of brown dwarfs mix several absorbers; the label names the dominant band only.
In the interstellar medium the same windows trace ices (H2O ice 3.05 um, CO2 ice 4.27 um, CO ice 4.67 um).
SPHEREx resolving power is ~35-130; windows narrower than one resolution element are not meaningful.

recipes.note: CH4 nu3 fundamental near 3.3 um; dominant absorber at 3-3.8 um in T and Y dwarfs.
Water vapour band at 2.7 um (and the 3.05 um water-ice feature in the ISM).
CO2 nu3 band at 4.26 um; seen in Y dwarf spectra (JWST) and as CO2 ice in the ISM.
CO fundamental (v=1-0) near 4.6 um; disequilibrium CO in cold brown dwarfs; CO ice 4.67 um in the ISM.
